propositions: Define Backend facade with five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three runtime-checkable capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) to enable pluggable backend implementations
Introduce RemoteRef dataclass with vendor, instance, and remote_id fields as the stable identity type pinned in ADR 0035 section (d)
Implement JiraBackend as a thin delegation wrapper over existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields) with zero behavior change and no logic relocation

Create IdentityConvention as a new pure convention object under adapters/jira/identity.py that formats RemoteRef to rebar-id label strings and parses them back, consolidating the four currently hand-inlined label formats

Develop backend-agnostic contract test suite parameterized over JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend, verifying outbound-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotency, identity parsing, and capability-based dispatch via isinstance guards

Establish characterization tests that pin exact current outputs of pure Jira mappers (_map_local_to_jira_fields, adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit, inbound extraction) to prove JiraBackend delegation is behavior-preserving
